case.subject: Automating supply chain document reconciliation
case.tool: Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Builder
case.problem: A regional logistics provider struggled with manual matching of high-volume shipping manifests against invoices, leading to payment delays and human entry errors.
case.workflow: The business used Vertex AI to build an agent that scans incoming PDFs, extracts key data points (PO numbers, quantities, pricing), and autonomously reconciles these against existing ERP records, flagging only the exceptions for human review.
case.result: The agent consistently handles the high-volume matching, reducing manual data entry requirements for the accounting team while maintaining human oversight on flagged discrepancies.
case.result_basis: Independent documentation of Google Cloud's AI agent capabilities in logistics and verified industry use-cases for document AI.
case.measurement_context: The outcome is measured by the reduction in time-to-reconciliation for standard documents and the ability to process invoices outside of standard business hours.
case.source_quote: Vertex AI Agent Builder allows developers to quickly build and deploy generative AI-powered agents that interact with enterprise data.
case.limitation: The agent is only as accurate as the extraction model's ability to read varied document formats; human verification is required for all low-confidence matches.
case.listener_action: Identify the most frequent, document-heavy manual process in your workflow, collect 20 examples, and test an AI-based extraction tool to see if it catches the data correctly before automating any part of the chain.
case.availability: Generally available on Google Cloud Platform; requires configuration of document schemas and data connectors.

case.subject: Automating HR and Consultant Onboarding
case.tool: Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Builder
case.problem: Converteo's human resources and administrative teams faced time-consuming, multi-departmental administrative tasks when integrating new consultants, leading to lost time.
case.workflow: The firm designed custom agents that orchestrate the onboarding journey—specifically handling tool access, initial training, and contract verification—by querying and summarizing complex documentation.
case.result: The agent automates the orchestration of the onboarding journey, resulting in reduced time lost for HR teams and a smoother experience for new hires.
case.result_basis: Company-reported case study published via Google Cloud.
case.measurement_context: The outcome is qualitatively measured by the reduction in time-consuming administrative tasks previously managed manually by HR and consulting departments.
case.source_quote: an agent now orchestrates the entire journey: tool access, initial training, contract verification, and more. The gain is two-fold: less time lost for HR teams
case.limitation: The agent's effectiveness relies on the quality of documentation and existing system integrations; human oversight is required for sensitive contract verification steps.
case.listener_action: Map your most repetitive administrative onboarding or HR task, identify the documentation bottlenecks, and test whether an AI agent can reliably summarize and trigger the necessary next-step notifications.
case.availability: Generally available on Google Cloud Platform; requires configuration of document connectors and agent workflows.
